resources.string: A short walkthrough for first-time users, plus answers to the problems people hit most often. Everything here is offline.
You can reopen this page anytime from Me

string-array.name: tutorial_steps
string-array.item: Install the runtime|The first launch stops on the Install runtime page — this is normal, the launcher always opens there. Tap Install and it unpacks the bundled Java runtime. No network needed; it takes a few minutes.
Download a game version|Open Download, pick a version, tap install. You can switch mirrors under Me → Download settings.
Sign in|Add an offline account (any name works) or a Microsoft account under Accounts. Offline accounts cannot join online-mode servers.
Allocate memory|Set memory under Me → Global game settings. Keep it under half of your phone RAM — more is not better, it makes crashes more likely.
Launch the game|Go back to Home and tap Launch. The first start does extra setup, so give it a moment.
If something goes wrong|Me → Startup diagnostics shows how far startup got. Me → Log center shows runtime logs. Both can be shared in one tap.

string-array.name: tutorial_faq
string-array.item: It crashes right after opening|Open Me → Startup diagnostics and look at the last line of the previous run — that is where it stopped. Share it with the author to get a precise answer.
First launch stops on Install runtime|That is the normal flow — the launcher entry point is that page. Once the runtime is installed, later launches go straight to the main screen.
Black screen / glitches / crash in game|Usually the renderer or memory. Try a different renderer (GL4ES / VirGL / native) and lower the allocated memory.
Downloads are slow or fail|Switch mirrors under Me → Download settings. Downloads support pause and resume; on failure tap Retry to re-download only the failed files.
Where do mods go|Put them in the mods folder of the instance. Resource packs go in resourcepacks, worlds in saves. You can also install them from Download → Mods.
Can I play very old versions|Yes. This launcher can download every archived legacy version and ships Chinese patches for all of them.
Will my data survive a reinstall|Your game directory is /sdcard/QCL/.minecraft. As long as it exists, versions and worlds are safe. Launcher settings live in app data and are cleared on uninstall.
